kitionAccount.signIn: Sign in to use Kition Cloud

document.description: Ask the agent to research, write, or organize this document.

summarize.label: Summarize this document
summarize.prompt: Summarize the current document into a Markdown brief

launchPlan.label: Draft a launch plan
launchPlan.prompt: Draft a launch plan from this document

checklist.label: Create a checklist
checklist.prompt: Create a checklist and save it as Markdown

workflow.description: Describe the workflow you want and the agent will draft the trigger + action.

emailOnRecord.label: Email me on every new record
emailOnRecord.prompt: When a record is created in this table, email me a summary of the record.

remindOnDate.label: Remind on a date field
remindOnDate.prompt: When today matches the deadline column on this table, send a reminder.

refine.label: Refine this workflow
refine.prompt: Look at the current workflow and suggest the next refinement.

table.description: Ask the agent to summarise, add columns, or query this table.

addStatusColumn.label: Add a status column
addStatusColumn.prompt: Add a single-select status column with options Not started, In progress, Done.

summarizeTable.label: Summarise this table
summarizeTable.prompt: Summarise the current table — column types, primary field, row count.

fillCells.label: Fill empty cells
fillCells.prompt: For each empty cell in the active column, suggest a value based on the other columns.

gallery.description: Ask the agent to organise, describe, or repurpose the media in this gallery.

describeEach.label: Describe each item
describeEach.prompt: Describe what is in each item in this gallery.

groupByTopic.label: Group by topic
groupByTopic.prompt: Group these media files by visual topic.

pickHero.label: Pick the hero
pickHero.prompt: Pick the strongest hero asset for a landing page.

whiteboard.description: Ask the agent to map ideas, organize the board, or create visual assets.

generateMindMap.label: Generate a mind map
generateMindMap.prompt: Turn my idea into a clear mind map on this Board.

organizeBoard.label: Organize this board
organizeBoard.prompt: Organize the current Board into clear groups and improve its layout.

generateImage.label: Generate an image
generateImage.prompt: Generate a visual for the selected idea and place it on this Board.

design.description: Develop your poster copy, colors, and images with the agent.

headline.label: Write a headline
headline.prompt: Help me write a short, memorable headline for a poster.

palette.label: Explore colors
palette.prompt: Suggest three color palettes for a modern poster and explain when to use each.

background.label: Create a background
background.prompt: Create a poster background with room for a headline. Ask me about the subject and style first.
